title: LinuxCNC INI Configuration — [TRAJ] Trajectory Planner Settings
locator: [TRAJ] section; ARC_BLEND_ENABLE, ARC_BLEND_FALLBACK_ENABLE and ARC_BLEND_OPTIMIZATION_DEPTH (look-ahead depth in number of segments).
notes: Official LinuxCNC-specific configuration documentation. The documented look-ahead setting and example depth are not universal CNC parameters and must not be copied to other controllers or machines.
